process PARABRICKS_MUTECTCALLER {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_high'
    label 'process_gpu'

    container "nvcr.io/nvidia/clara/clara-parabricks:4.8.0-1"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(tumor_bam), path(tumor_bam_index), path(normal_bam), path(normal_bam_index), path(intervals)
    tuple val(meta2), path(fasta), path(fasta_fai)
    path panel_of_normals
    path panel_of_normals_index
    path germline_resource
    path germline_resource_index
    path alleles
    path alleles_index

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.vcf.gz"),       emit: vcf
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.vcf.gz.tbi"),   emit: tbi
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.vcf.gz.stats"), emit: stats
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.f1r2.tar.gz"),  emit: f1r2, optional: true
    path "compatible_versions.yml",                  emit: compatible_versions, optional: true
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('parabricks'), eval("pbrun version | grep -m1 '^pbrun:' | sed 's/^pbrun:[[:space:]]*//'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_parabricks

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    // Exit if running this module with -profile conda / -profile mamba
    if (workflow.profile.tokenize(',').intersect(['conda', 'mamba']).size() >= 1) {
        exit(1, "Parabricks module does not support Conda. Please use Docker / Singularity / Podman instead.")
    }

    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"

    def intervals_command  = intervals     ? (intervals instanceof List ? intervals.collect { interval -> "--interval-file ${interval}" }.join(' ') : "--interval-file ${intervals}") : ""
    // prepon and postpon expect the index at <pon>.tbi
    def pon_index_command = panel_of_normals && panel_of_normals_index.name != "${panel_of_normals.name}.tbi" ? "cp -L ${panel_of_normals_index} ${panel_of_normals}.tbi" : ""
    def prepon_command = panel_of_normals ? "pbrun prepon --in-pon-file ${panel_of_normals} --preserve-file-symlinks" : ""
    def pon_command    = panel_of_normals ? "--pon ${panel_of_normals}" : ""
    // pbrun postpon requires uncompressed .vcf input; output uncompressed when PON is provided
    def mutect_out     = panel_of_normals ? "${prefix}.vcf"    : "${prefix}.vcf.gz"
    def stats_rename   = panel_of_normals ? "mv ${prefix}.vcf.stats ${prefix}.vcf.gz.stats" : ""
    def postpon_command = panel_of_normals ? "pbrun postpon --in-vcf ${prefix}.vcf --in-pon-file ${panel_of_normals} --out-vcf ${prefix}.vcf.gz --preserve-file-symlinks" : ""

    // mutectcaller expects the germline resource index at <germline_resource>.tbi
    def germline_index_command = germline_resource && germline_resource_index.name != "${germline_resource.name}.tbi" ? "cp -L ${germline_resource_index} ${germline_resource}.tbi" : ""
    def germline_command = germline_resource ? "--mutect-germline-resource ${germline_resource}" : ""

    // mutectcaller only finds the alleles index at <alleles>.tbi and reads the VCF without it otherwise
    def alleles_index_command = alleles && alleles_index.name != "${alleles.name}.tbi" ? "cp -L ${alleles_index} ${alleles}.tbi" : ""
    def alleles_command = alleles ? "--mutect-alleles ${alleles}" : ""

    def num_gpus = task.accelerator ? "--num-gpus ${task.accelerator.request}" : ""
    def normal_bam_flag = normal_bam ? "--in-normal-bam ${normal_bam}" : ""
    """
    # if panel of normals specified, place its index at <pon>.tbi and run prepon
    ${pon_index_command}
    ${prepon_command}

    ${germline_index_command}
    ${alleles_index_command}

    pbrun \\
        mutectcaller \\
        --ref ${fasta} \\
        --in-tumor-bam ${tumor_bam} \\
        ${normal_bam_flag} \\
        ${pon_command} \\
        ${germline_command} \\
        ${alleles_command} \\
        --out-vcf ${mutect_out} \\
        ${intervals_command} \\
        ${num_gpus} \\
        --preserve-file-symlinks \\
        ${args}

    # if panel of normals specified, rename stats and run postpon
    ${stats_rename}
    ${postpon_command}
    """

    stub:
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.vcf.gz
    touch ${prefix}.vcf.gz.tbi
    touch ${prefix}.vcf.gz.stats
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.f1r2.tar.gz

    # Capture the full version output once and store it in a variable
    pbrun_version_output=\$(pbrun mutectcaller --version 2>&1)

    # Generate compatible_versions.yml
    cat <<EOF > compatible_versions.yml
    "${task.process}":
        pbrun_version: \$(echo "\$pbrun_version_output" | grep "pbrun:" | awk '{print \$2}')
        compatible_with:
        \$(echo "\$pbrun_version_output" | awk '/Compatible With:/,/^---/{ if (\$1 ~ /^[A-Z]/ && \$1 != "Compatible" && \$1 != "---") { printf "  %s: %s\\n", \$1, \$2 } }')
    EOF
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/parabricks/mutectcaller"
description: "NVIDIA Clara Parabricks GPU-accelerated somatic variant calling, replicating\
  \ GATK Mutect2."
keywords:
- "variant"
- "vcf"
- "mutect2"
- "mutect"
- "somatic"
tools:
- parabricks:
    description: "NVIDIA Clara Parabricks GPU-accelerated genomics tools"
    homepage: "https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/clara/genomics/"
    documentation: "https://docs.nvidia.com/clara/parabricks/latest/index.html"
    licence:
    - "custom"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
  - tumor_bam:
      type: "file"
      description: "bam file for tumor sample."
      pattern: "*.bam"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  - tumor_bam_index:
      type: "file"
      description: "(Optional) bai or csi index corresponding to tumor bam file. Only\
        \ required if intervals are provided."
      pattern: "*.{bai,csi}"
      ontologies: []
  - normal_bam:
      type: "file"
      description: "(Optional) bam file for normal sample in tumor-vs-normal calling."
      pattern: "*.bam"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  - normal_bam_index:
      type: "file"
      description: "(Optional) bai or csi index corresponding to normal bam file.\
        \ Only required if intervals are provided."
      pattern: "*.{bai,csi}"
      ontologies: []
  - intervals:
      type: "file"
      description: "(Optional) file or files containing genomic intervals for use\
        \ in base quality score recalibration."
      pattern: "*.{bed,interval_list,picard,list,intervals}"
      ontologies: []
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference and index information\n[ id:'homo_sapiens'\
        \ ]\n"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "reference fasta - must be unzipped."
      pattern: "*.fasta"
      ontologies: []
  - fasta_fai:
      type: "file"
      description: "(Optional) reference fasta index."
      pattern: "*.fai"
      ontologies: []
- panel_of_normals:
    type: "file"
    description: "(Optional) bgzipped panel of normals file. When provided, the module\
      \ runs\nprepon, passes it to mutectcaller via --pon and annotates the output\
      \ with\npostpon. Its header must contain only contigs present in the reference,\n\
      otherwise prepon fails with \"Chromosome number of pon file doesn't match\n\
      reference\" (see `bcftools reheader --fai`). Do not add --pon via ext.args.\n"
    pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
    ontologies:
    - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
- panel_of_normals_index:
    type: "file"
    description: "(Optional) tbi index corresponding to panel of normals file."
    pattern: "*.tbi"
    ontologies: []
- germline_resource:
    type: "file"
    description: "(Optional) bgzipped population VCF of germline sequencing containing\
      \ allele\nfractions, passed to mutectcaller via --mutect-germline-resource.\n"
    pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
    ontologies:
    - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
- germline_resource_index:
    type: "file"
    description: "(Optional) tbi index corresponding to the germline resource file.\
      \ Copied to <germline_resource>.tbi if named differently."
    pattern: "*.tbi"
    ontologies: []
- alleles:
    type: "file"
    description: "(Optional) bgzipped VCF of alleles to force-call regardless of evidence,\n\
      passed to mutectcaller via --mutect-alleles.\n"
    pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
    ontologies:
    - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
- alleles_index:
    type: "file"
    description: "(Optional) tbi index corresponding to the alleles file. Copied to\
      \ <alleles>.tbi if named differently."
    pattern: "*.tbi"
    ontologies: []
output:
  vcf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.vcf.gz:
        type: "file"
        description: "Compressed variants file. Will include an annotated vcf file\
          \ if panel of normals is used."
        pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  tbi:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.vcf.gz.tbi:
        type: "file"
        description: "Tabix index of the compressed variants file."
        pattern: "*.vcf.gz.tbi"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3700"
  stats:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.vcf.gz.stats:
        type: "file"
        description: "Variant statistics."
        pattern: "*.vcf.gz.stats"
        ontologies: []
  f1r2:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.f1r2.tar.gz:
        type: "file"
        description: "(Optional) F1R2 counts for learnreadorientationmodel, written\
          \ when\n--mutect-f1r2-tar-gz ${prefix}.f1r2.tar.gz is set via ext.args.\n"
        pattern: "*.f1r2.tar.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  compatible_versions:
  - compatible_versions.yml:
      type: "file"
      description: "File containing info on compatible CPU-based software versions."
      pattern: "compatible_versions.yml"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3750"
  versions_parabricks:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The process the versions were collected from"
    - parabricks:
        type: "string"
        description: "The tool name"
    - pbrun version | grep -m1 '^pbrun:' | sed 's/^pbrun:[[:space:]]*//':
        type: "string"
        description: "The command used to generate the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The process the versions were collected from"
    - parabricks:
        type: "string"
        description: "The tool name"
    - pbrun version | grep -m1 '^pbrun:' | sed 's/^pbrun:[[:space:]]*//':
        type: "string"
        description: "The command used to generate the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@bsiranosian"
maintainers:
- "@famosab"
version: "0.0.0-5eae6c7"
